title: Split argument scanning from command validation

promptSteps.prompt: `parseArgs` in src/args.js does two jobs at once: it walks the argument list collecting flags, and it decides whether a particular command has what it needs. Please separate them. Keep `parseArgs(argv)` exactly as callers see it today, and add an exported `scanFlags(argv)` that takes the arguments after the command name and returns `{ flags, positional }`: `flags` maps each option to its value, using `true` for `--json` and `--all-tenants`, and `positional` holds the remaining arguments in order. `scanFlags` reports a flag without a value and an unknown flag the same way the code does today; deciding what a command requires stays in `parseArgs`. This is a rearrangement, not a change: every message, every exit code, and every accepted invocation stays exactly as it is. Run `npm test` in the project root to check your work.
